# Atif Malik — Pakistan's No.1 AI Video Production & Automation Agency

## Who
Atif Malik is Pakistan's No.1 AI Video Production and Automation specialist with 800+ projects delivered and 5+ years of experience. He builds cinematic AI video content, end-to-end automation systems, and intelligent AI agents for businesses worldwide.

## Services
- AI Video Production: Cinematic AI videos, product ads, social content using Higgsfield AI, Seedance 2.0, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro, Google VEO, ElevenLabs, Remotion
- AI Automation: n8n workflows, GoHighLevel, API integrations, CRM automation, business process automation
- AI Agents: Customer support agents, sales qualification, lead capture, appointment booking using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini
- AI Chatbots: Multi-platform bots for WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, websites
- AI Content Systems: Automated content pipelines, social media automation, publishing workflows
- AI Websites & Web Apps: Premium Next.js sites, SaaS MVPs, dashboards, custom tools
- Lead & Sales Automation: Lead capture, qualification, follow-up sequences, CRM, booking automation
- Custom AI Systems: Bespoke architecture for complex requirements
- AI Graphic Novels: Full novel-to-graphic-novel conversion, character design, 300 DPI print-ready pages for Amazon KDP
